configurations.name: emulators-demo
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y node@22 node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:start --project demo-open-feedback --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --import=./cypress/fixtures/firebase-emulators-data

configurations.name: web-demo
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && VITE_APPID=1:000000000000:web:0000000000000000 VITE_API_KEY=demo-api-key VITE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-open-feedback.firebaseapp.com VITE_PROJECT_ID=demo-open-feedback VITE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-open-feedback.appspot.com VITE_EMULATORS=true npx -y node@22 node_modules/.bin/vite --port "${PORT:-3100}" --strictPort
